items.title: 6.6 Reaction ki enthalpy tabdeeli ki paimaish (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.6, printed page 124.

blocks.text: Tabee ya kimiyai tabdeeli ke dauran kharij ya jazb hararat calorimeter se napi jati hai, jo aam taur par amal ke dauran darja hararat ki tabdeeli napta hai; sab se sada soorat mein yeh ek insulated bartan hai jis mein stirrer aur thermometer hain. Calorimetry is haqeeqat par qaim hai ke 4.18 J energy 1 g pani ka darja hararat 1 degree C barhati hai.

blocks.title: Specific heat capacity
blocks.text: Kisi madde ke 1 kg ka darja hararat 1 K (ya 1 degree C) barhane ke liye darkar hararat us ki specific heat capacity, c, hai; pani ke liye yeh 4.18 J fi g fi K hai (print 4.184 aur 4.2 bhi istemal karti hai).

Hararat ke taur par muntaqil energy q = c x m x delta T hai, jahan q joules mein hararat, m grams mein pani ya solution ka mass, c pani ki specific heat aur delta T degrees C mein darja hararat ki tabdeeli hai, delta T = Tf - Ti.

blocks.prompt: Pani ka 150 g namoona 20.0 se 24.0 degrees C tak garam hota hai. Us ne kitni hararat jazb ki?
blocks.explanation: q = m x c x delta T = 150 x 4.18 x 4.0 = 2508 J, taqreeban 2.5 kJ.

items: Calorimeter (insulated bartan, stirrer, thermometer) darja hararat ki tabdeeli se hararat napta hai; q = m c delta T, pani ka c 4.18 J fi g fi K.
